item.title: Celebrate Australia Day with Monaco’s Australian Association
item.description: This Australia Day, Monaco’s expat community is invited to celebrate with the Principality’s official Australian Association — all while enjoying front-row views of the Sainte Dévote festivities.

item.title: Monaco chef tackles Mediterranean’s lion fish crisis through art and cuisine
item.description: Marius restaurant's Didier Rubiolo's solution is quite simple: if you can't beat them, eat them. The chef has developed recipes showcasing the fish's white, flaky flesh, which he describes as similar to grouper or snapper. "Small steps can produce great changes," he said.

item.title: Prince Albert II in Davos: Ocean protection is economic strategy, not charity
item.description: Prince Albert II argued that the question facing world leaders is no longer whether to act for the ocean, but how to act at the scale that the moment demands.

item.title: Exclusive interview: Australian Ambassador to Monaco Lynette Wood
item.description: To mark Australia Day, Cassandra Tanti speaks with Ambassador Lynette Wood on diplomacy and Australia–Monaco ties. “If the world is teaching us anything right now, it’s never to take your country’s diplomatic relationships for granted.”

item.title: Monaco advances anti-corruption strategy in response to European watchdog
item.description: Minister of State Christophe Mirmand is steering Monaco through its response to a critical evaluation by European corruption watchdog GRECO, with a new framework expected to be unveiled soon.

item.title: Woman found dead in Beausoleil home, husband held in custody
item.description: An 88-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of killing his 85-year-old wife after her body was discovered at their home in Beausoleil on Sunday, according to the Nice prosecutor's office.

item.title: Prince Albert II watches Team Monaco make E1 World Championship debut in Jeddah
item.description: The Sovereign attended the opening round in Saudi Arabia as the Principality's electric raceboat team competed for the first time, with Aoki Racing claiming victory in the Red Sea final.

item.title: Barbagiuans win Fight Aids Cup on penalties as Charles Leclerc makes surprise appearance
item.description: The Barbagiuans of Monaco have claimed the sixth Fight AIDS Cup title following a tense penalty shootout at the Stade Louis-II, with Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc making a surprise appearance in the warm-up and opening half.

item.title: Monaco’s Jardin Animalier to undergo major modernisation after safety works
item.description: Prince Albert II has ordered an ambitious upgrade of the animal garden founded by his father, with expanded habitats and immersive visitor experience planned following cliff safety operations.

item.title: Solberg makes history with debut Monte Carlo Rally win
item.description: Swedish driver Oliver Solberg secured his maiden Rallye Monte-Carlo victory as thousands gathered in Monaco’s Port Hercule for a thrilling street rally.
